capabilities: paste Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers or LibreOffice Calc data as Markdown tables
paste single-column tables via hotkey or command palette
reassign the paste hotkey from settings
extras: Single-column tables are only pasted via the hotkey or command palette, not normal paste.
problem: Pasting cells copied from spreadsheet apps into the editor produces non-Markdown text instead of a usable table.
summary: Spreadsheet paste converter that turns clipboard data from Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers and LibreOffice Calc into Markdown tables.
